name: Deep Fried Mars Bar
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 Mars Bar (UK/Canada) or 1 Milky Way bar (USA)
Enough oil to fill the pot or fryer you are using (oil or fat can be used as well as suet for authenticity)

steps: Chill, but do not freeze, the Mars bar by leaving it in a fridge or freezer for a short while.
Mix the milk, flour, and egg in a bowl. Whisk together to create a creamy batter.
Coat the Mars bar completely in batter.
Lower into hot oil and fry until batter is golden brown. Be careful to lower it gently; otherwise the batter may come off.

culture.text: A deep-fried Mars bar is a Mars-brand chocolate bar covered in batter then deep fried in oil. The dish originated at a chip shop in Scotland as a novelty item. Since various mass media began reporting on the practice in the mid-1990s – often as a critical commentary on how unhealthy the Scottish diet was – the popularity of the dish has spread.
